title: Attention
items: Change blindness = missing a change. Inattentional blindness = missing an object entirely. Both: attention is elsewhere.
Cocktail party effect: hearing your name in a noisy room. Pop-out: the one odd item jumps out.

title: Processing
items: Bottom-up = senses up to the brain (sensation).

title: Thresholds
items: Absolute threshold = weakest stimulus detected 50% of the time.
Difference threshold (JND) = smallest change noticed 50% of the time.
Weber's law: a constant percentage, not a constant amount (weight: about 2%).

title: ESP
items: Telepathy, clairvoyance, precognition: no scientific basis.
Psychics seem accurate because people remember hits and forget misses.
